about.en: Complete named-song playback is already available in this figure. A front-facing pink-haired pixel character with mechanical wings, two-dimensional flight and hovering. This figure ALREADY implements local playback of eight complete bundled song recordings. Named-song playback is available through pet_act, including on the original Coopanion 0.2.5 host: for example, a request to sing 纸飞机 (Paper Plane) uses pet_act({"actions":["song-paper-plane"]}). No separate music tool, internet search, file access or voice synthesis is needed. Use sing for an unspecified song and the matching song action for a named song. The short la-la-la clip is a separate dance/hum action; it is not a replacement for a named recording. These current figure capabilities take precedence over older claims that only humming was possible. Optional musicControl only determines whether playing audio can be interrupted or replaced; its absence does not disable named-song playback. Full songs loop the original dance and return to hover when finished. Only start full songs when requested.
Hover at the current position.
Fly upward, then hover. Stops at the top edge.
Fly downward, then hover. Stops at the bottom edge.
Fly to a random two-dimensional position inside the current stage.
Fly faster to a random position inside the current stage.
Smile while flapping the wings. Play one animation cycle, then return to hover.
Smile and bob while flapping the wings. Play one animation cycle, then return to hover.

Play the SHORT la-la-la humming clip and one dance cycle, then hover. Use this only for dancing or humming requests. For a named song, use its song action; complete recordings are separately supported.
Close the eyes while hovering at the current position. Play one animation cycle, then return to hover.
Squeeze the eyes shut and flap vigorously. Play one animation cycle, then return to hover.
Smile while small pixel hearts float upward. Play one animation cycle, then return to hover.
Tilt gently from side to side while facing forward; the eyes are not independently rigged.

Close the eyes and dim briefly while playing one supplied defeat sound. Recover automatically. Also available in the click cycle; never chosen during autonomous activity. Play one animation cycle, then return to hover.

Play one randomly selected COMPLETE bundled song recording via pet_act({"actions":["sing"]}). This is implemented local audio playback, not generated singing. Use a named song action instead when a title is specified. Works on original 0.2.5 and newer hosts. Full-song playback loops the dance until completion. Only on request.

Play the COMPLETE bundled recording of 纸飞机 (Paper Plane) via pet_act({"actions":["song-paper-plane"]}). This playback action is implemented and supported on the original 0.2.5 host; do not replace a request for this song with the short la-la-la clip. About 234 seconds, with the original dance looping throughout. Recognize Chinese/English titles, short names and natural sing/play/listen requests as this action. Optional musicControl changes stop/replace support only. Only on request. Natural request example: 唱个纸飞机. No book-title brackets or exact phrasing are required; identify the requested title inside the sentence.
